comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Like all pet quests, you do NOT receive a pet deed upon completion. Go to the Trainer NPC found in all six player capital cities (Seville, London, etc.) and you will find the deed stored there. You may collect it then if you desire to or you can choose to leave it for another time.

Note that a Trainer can hold 1 pet deed for each pet indefinitely, but until you collect a pet deed you may not repeat the repeat its quest to obtain another. Cheers.
